en: Dig down. Sting everything. Bring the treasure home.
Field note: cracked it open expecting quartz. Found more rock, but angrier.
Field note: volcanic glass, three hundred metres from the nearest volcano. Somebody brought it here.
Field note: the brand is long gone, but the crimp still has some fight in it.
Field note: the beetle on this amulet looks a lot like the beetles in the walls. Coincidence, surely.
Field note: tiny, red and pointed. Fits perfectly. It may have been waiting for us.
Charge a beam of buried light
Field note: still warm. Down here, nothing should still be warm.
Something small is lost among the roots.
